newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGAS RAUGS PAYS FIVE SANTIMES DIVIDEND.
newsitem.headline: RIGAS RAUGS PAYS FIVE SANTIMES DIVIDEND.

text.p: Rigas Raugs yeast factory shareholders approved a 1997 budget with a profit of 155,000 lats against 176,900 lats and decided to pay a 1996 dividend of five santimes, shareholders said.
Raugs plans a net turnover of 1.38 million lats in 1997 and a lower profit figure due to growing energy and raw material prices. These figures were approved by a shareholder meeting on Saturday.
Raugs does not plan to raise prices as it sees growing competition on the Latvian market from Estonia and France.
Raugs total undivided profit of 1995 and 1996 came to 231,422 lats with 21,150 lats to be paid in dividends. Some 115,000 lats will be invested in the company.

Raugs plans to focus on the bakery market and does not see itself diversifying into the beer or the medical products market, a represenative for the shareholder of a controlling stake, Nordic Yeast AB, told shareholders.
